newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks bounce back to end slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks bounce back to end slightly up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks bounced back towards the close on Thursday after a weak start as a rise in select blue chips offset profit-taking by speculators ahead of the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.
"Interest in select energy and bank scrips pushed the index up," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said. "But the market is confused and directionless. Investors are in a wait-and-see mood."

The Karachi 100-share index rose 2.93 points, or 0.21 percent, to end at 1,430.24 from 1,420.19 at noon. Losers led gainers 154 to 90. Pak Oil Fields rose 5.0 rupees to 75 and Sui Northern Gas 1.50 to 40.50. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
